findings.quote: and one may grasp the magnitude of that change from what follows.
findings.problem: Greek: γνοίη δ᾽ ἄν τις τὸ μέγεθος τῆς μεταβολῆς ἐκ τούτων. ζήτει ἐν τῷ περὶ στρατηγίας. The excerptor's note ('look in the section on generalship') shows the excerpt breaks off here: the passage that 'follows' (ἐκ τούτων) is not transmitted. The English reads straight on into an unrelated fragment as if the promised illustration came next.
findings.proposed_fix: and one may grasp the magnitude of that change from what follows. [...]

units.note: Final fragment (τὸ γὰρ ἀδύνατον ἐν τῷ ψεύδει μόνον οὐδ᾽ ἀπολογίαν ἐπιδέχεται) is ambiguous in scope of μόνον: either 'only in a falsehood does impossibility admit no excuse' (current) or 'in falsehood, impossibility alone admits not even an excuse'. Isolated marginal fragment without context; no fix proposed.
